$comment: One icon per Career achievement (Mage.Server/src/main/resources/career/achievements.json). Locked and secret states are CSS treatments of the same picture.
style: Achievement emblems: one single treasured object per cell, three-quarter view, gilded antique gold with jewel or enamel accents, rendered like a precious trophy in a medal case. Each object fills about 75% of its cell. Bold readable silhouette at small sizes.
